literal: If internal enmity of an unfitting mind arises, it will bring many ruins that make one's kin discordant.
translation: If internal enmity arises from an insincere mind, it will bring many ruins that destroy the unity of one's kinsmen.
modern: மனம் ஒன்றாத உட்பகை ஒருவனுக்குள் தோன்றினால், அது அவனுடைய சுற்றத்தாரைப் பிரிக்கும் பல துன்பங்களைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the severe dangers of hidden, internal hatred. When internal enmity arises from a discordant or insincere mind, it does not remain a quiet grudge. It actively works to divide and ruin one's own group or kinsmen. Ultimately, this internal division brings about numerous forms of disaster and ruin to the entire household or community.
